cands.name: Artis "A.J." McCampbell

money.note: Covers January 2023 on, primary and general. Party-committee lines are often in-kind staff and mail.
money.source: Alabama Fair Campaign Practices Act system, downloaded Nov 5, 2026

cands.bio: Democrat who has represented Alabama House District 71 since 2006. Insurance agent by profession. Earlier worked as an investigator for the district attorney's office in the 17th Judicial Circuit, a juvenile probation officer, and an investigator and patrolman for the City of Tuscaloosa. University of Alabama graduate (1976).
cands.gaps: We couldn't find where McCampbell was born or raised, or when he came to Alabama. We found no documented actions, sponsored bills or stated positions on data centers, homestead taxes, land ownership, growth, immigration, policing, guns, abortion or schools. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2022 or 2026, and the page we read lists no sponsored bills. No endorsements, controversies or foreign ties turned up in the material we had. The only source available was his Ballotpedia page, and the dates of his earlier jobs are not given.

qual.background: Alabama House member for District 71 since 2006 (20 years). Insurance agent, former district attorney's office investigator, juvenile probation officer, and Tuscaloosa investigator and patrolman.
qual.why: Two decades of legislative service and a long record of real-world work put him in the high range. Committee seats, including Ways and Means General Fund, were not counted.
